name: @cbartens/bkit
description: Agent-stack consolidation CLI — distributed via GitHub Packages npm registry (@cbartens:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com).

scripts.check:dist: rm -rf dist && tsc && git diff --exit-code dist/ || (echo '[bkit] dist/ is stale — run pnpm build and commit the result' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:prose: bash -c 'if command -v vale >/dev/null 2>&1; then FILES=$(find .agents -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md"; find .agents/workflows .agents/prompts -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null; find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md"); vale $FILES; else echo "[bkit] vale not in PATH — skipping"; fi'
